Many failures due to bump functions not resetting minor/patch to 0. In bump_major, we should set minor and patch to 0. We currently keep same values. Need to modify bump_major/minor/patch functions accordingly.

Also bump_prerelease and bump_build should ignore build for prerelease and ignore prerelease for build? Actually bump_prerelease currently uses parts["build"] but should ignore build metadata? In tests, bump_prerelease('3.4.5-rc.1+build.4') expected '3.4.5-rc.2' no build. So we need to set build to None. Similarly bump_build should ignore prerelease? In bump_build test, bump_build('3.4.5-rc.1+build.1') expected '3.4.5-rc.2+build.2' meaning prerelease preserved, build incremented. Good.

Also bump functions should ignore extensions: bump_patch('3.4.5-rc1+build4') expected '3.4.6' no prerelease or build. So bump functions should drop prerelease and build unless bump_prerelease or bump_build. So bump_patch should ignore prerelease and build.

Also bump_major/minor should ignore prerelease and build.

Also bump_prerelease should ignore build.

Also bump_build should ignore prerelease? Wait test for bump_build('3.4.5-rc.1+build.1') expected '3.4.5-rc.2+build.2', prerelease preserved. So bump_build should preserve prerelease, but ignore build metadata? It increments build. That's fine.

Also bump_prerelease('3.4.5-rc.1+build.4') expected '3.4.5-rc.2' drop build. Good.

Also bump_prerelease('3.4.5-rc.1+build.1') expected '3.4.5-rc.2+build.2' but test earlier expects that? Wait test for bump_prerelease and build: They chain bump_prerelease().bump_build() expecting '3.4.5-rc.2+build.2'. So bump_prerelease should drop build, then bump_build adds build. Good.

Also bump functions should ignore extensions: bump_major('3.4.5-rc1+build4') expected '4.0.0'. So drop prerelease and build.

Also bump_prerelease('3.4.5-rc.1+build.4') expected '3.4.5-rc.2' drop build.

Also bump_build should ignore prerelease? No.

Also bump functions for versioninfo: need methods bump_major, bump_minor, bump_patch, bump_prerelease, bump_build on VersionInfo. We can add methods that use bump functions and return new VersionInfo.

Also _increment_string: test expects rc -> rc (no increment because no numeric). Our implementation increments first numeric substring. rc has no numeric, so should return "rc1" but expected "rc". So _increment_string should return original if no numeric substring. So modify accordingly.

Also bump functions should use parse to get parts, then apply logic: major bump: new major+1, minor=0, patch=0, prerelease=None, build=None. minor bump: major same, minor+1, patch=0, prerelease=None, build=None. patch bump: major same, minor same, patch+1, prerelease=None, build=None.

bump_prerelease: use parts, new prerelease: if pre None: token.1 else increment numeric. build=None.

bump_build: use parts, new build: token or increment numeric. prerelease preserved.

Also bump_build should preserve prerelease but ignore build? Actually increment build, keep prerelease.

Also bump_build should ignore build? No, it increments build.

Also bump_build should ignore build? Wait test for bump_build('3.4.5-rc.1+build.1') expects '3.4.5-rc.2+build.2' meaning prerelease preserved, build incremented. Good.

Also bump_build('3.4.5+build.1') expected '3.4.5+build.2' no prerelease.

Also bump_build('3.4.5-rc.1+build.1') expected '3.4.5-rc.2+build.2' after chaining.

Also bump_build should ignore prerelease? No.

Also bump_build should ignore build? It increments.

Also bump_build should ignore build? No.

Also bump_build should ignore build? Enough.

Also bump functions should ignore prerelease and build for major/minor/patch. So set prerelease=None, build=None.

Also bump_prerelease should ignore build. So set build=None.

Also bump_build should preserve prerelease.

Also bump_build should ignore build? No.

Also bump_build should ignore build? Enough.

Also bump_prerelease should ignore build.
